articles.title: Critical Langflow AI Vulnerabilities Allow Hackers to Execute Remote Code Without Authentication
articles.summary:

The bulletin addresses Langflow versions 1.0.0 through 1.12.8 and advises administrators to upgrade to version 1.13.0.
